title: Mandukya Upanishad
author: Atharvaveda
intro: The shortest of the principal Upanishads: twelve prose mantras on Om and the four states of the Self. Waking is A, dream is U, deep sleep is M, and the fourth, turiya, is the silence beyond them. Shankara's teacher's teacher, Gaudapada, wrote his famous Karika on it, and it is the root of Advaita Vedanta.
note: The Upanishad is in prose, so the meter scanner is replaced by a note on each mantra. It opens with the Atharvaveda Shanti Mantra, भद्रं कर्णेभिः. Notice the words pada (quarter) and matra (measure): the same words used for the quarters and syllable-lengths of a verse.
